newsitem.title: INDIA: GEC Alsthom in talks on India joint venture.
newsitem.headline: GEC Alsthom in talks on India joint venture.

text.p: GEC Alsthom, a joint venture of General Electric Company and France's Alsthom group, has shown interest in investing around $42 million in an Indian transport parts plant, an Indian official said on Monday.

"GEC Alsthom is interested in collaborating with BEML for the manufacture of transport components. The investment planned is around 1.5 billion rupees ($41.8 million)," J.H. Patel, chief minister of the southern state of Karnataka, told reporters.
Bharat Earth Movers Ltd (BEML), a state-run engineering company, is based in Bangalore, Karnataka's state capital.
GEC Alsthom India is the Indian joint venture of the two companies.
Patel returned on Monday from a 15-day tour of Britain and the United States to scout for investments in his state. ($1=35.8 rupees)
